question: Will Google have the #1 AI model on the highest-profile general reasoning performance benchmark at the end of October 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if, at any point strictly after 2026-10-05T07:28:36.156Z and at or before 2026-10-31T16:00:00.000Z, a Google-developed model holds the #1 ranked position on the LMArena overall text leaderboard by Arena Elo score.
- "No": Wins if no Google-developed model holds the #1 ranked position on the LMArena overall text leaderboard at any point within the same window.

Clarifications:
- "Google-developed model" is any model publicly attributed to Google, Google DeepMind, or a Google subsidiary (e.g., a Gemini-family model).
- The #1 position is determined by the highest Arena Elo rank as publicly displayed on the leaderboard at any snapshot within the window.
